refrigerant.note: Manual lists digit 7 E = R-410A and F = microchannel condenser coils, but doesn't state the refrigerant for F explicitly. Confirm on the nameplate.

voltage.note: Digit 8 = '3' is not listed in RT-SVX37B-EN (50 Hz edition lists only D = 380-415/50/3). Needs the 60 Hz IOM or the nameplate.

controller.note: Digit 9 = E = Electromechanical. Model-number digits decoded from the 50 Hz edition's Model Number Description. Confirm against the 60 Hz IOM when available.

blowerDrive.note: Digit 15 = 0, standard efficiency 3-phase 3-8½ ton = belt drive. Assumes 3-phase supply (digit 8 not yet verified).

chargeLbsCircuit1.note: Factory charge not available without the unit manual / nameplate.

hpsCutoutPsig.note: HPC is standard (p.5) but its setpoint is not in RT-SVX37B-EN. Typical R-410A value until the Service Facts/60 Hz IOM is added.

factoryEconomizer.note: Model notes 3 and 30 (p.5): enthalpy economizers and DCV are not available with electromechanical controls.

honeywellJade.note: No factory fresh-air option on this unit (digit 14 = 0), so any economizer is field-installed.

cc1.note: Field power lands on CC1 line side in the control panel.

controller.note: Electromechanical unit: Y1 from the thermostat drives CC1 through the safeties. Confirm rung order on the unit wiring diagram.

cfm1CapUf.note: Condenser fan run capacitor rating not confirmed; read the capacitor label / parts list.

sequenceOfOperation.note: Electromechanical sequence not detailed in RT-SVX37B-EN (its sequence/troubleshooting sections are ReliaTel). Replace from the unit wiring diagram / 60 Hz IOM.
value: Thermostat G: indoor fan contactor energizes the IDM (belt drive).
Thermostat Y1: 24 V passes through the high-pressure (HPC1) and low-pressure (LPC1) controls to the CC1 coil. CC1 starts the compressor and outdoor fan.
No microprocessor: no lockout counter, no diagnostics display, no anti-short-cycle logic unless a field thermostat provides it.
A safety opening drops CC1 directly. When it recloses, the compressor restarts on the next call.

cooling-95F.note: Representative healthy-unit readings at 95°F OA / 75°F RA. Not Trane charging-chart values.

readings.txt_tstat: Thermostat: Cool, setpoint 73°F, space 75°F. Y1 and G energized.
readings.txt_controller: No unit controller on this unit (electromechanical). Nothing to read but the thermostat and the safeties.
readings.txt_look_unit: Unit running. Compressor steady, outdoor fan spinning, blower running.
readings.txt_look_condenser: Coil reasonably clean. Fan turning, warm discharge air.
readings.txt_look_evap: Filters average. Coil sweating evenly. Belt OK.
readings.txt_look_economizer: Damper about 20% open. Linkage tight. Mixed air sensor downstream of the dampers, ahead of filters.
readings.txt_manual_stroke: Damper strokes freely through full travel by hand.
readings.txt_jade_checkout: DAMPER OPEN: actuator drives full open, blades follow. DAMPER CLOSE: drives closed, blades seal.

condenserCoil.note: Digit 7 = F. Note 23 (p.5): standard on TSC 6 ton standard efficiency.

meteringDevice.note: Model note 10: standard metering devices are TXVs.

highPressureControl.note: Model note 5. Setpoint not in this manual.

refrigerationControls.value: None: no Frostat, no crankcase heater
refrigerationControls.note: Digit 23 = 0. Note 11: Frostat cannot be field-installed on electromechanical units.

smokeDetectors.value: Supply and return air smoke detectors (factory)

manualFacts.value: Max allowable supply voltage imbalance 2.0%. Over 2% can mean up to 20% current imbalance.
manualFacts.note: Also p.9: DLTS (discharge line temp switch) in series with HPC/LPC opens over 300°F dome temp where fitted. Applicability to this electromechanical model not stated.
